package fixture

func registerIsFinite(v *interp.VM) {
	ad := codes.DisplayName(codes.FnIsFinite)
	wrap(v, codes.FnIsFinite, func(old interp.BuiltinFunc) interp.BuiltinFunc {
		return func(m *interp.VM, args []interp.Value, named map[string]interp.Value) (interp.Value, error) {
			if err := bind.CheckNamed(ad+"()", named); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			if len(args) == 1 {
				if err := listError(ad, args[0], messages.Text(messages.H6131), ad+"("+codes.Name(codes.FnTensor)+"(...))"); err != nil {
					return nil, err
				}
			}
			d, ok := singleTensor(args)
			if !ok {
				return oldCall(ad, old, m, args, named)
			}
			r, err := safe(func() *tensor.Tensor { return isFinite(d.t) })
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return New(r), nil
		}
	})
}

func registerRounding(v *interp.VM, kd codes.Code, fn func(*tensor.Tensor) *tensor.Tensor) {
	ad := codes.DisplayName(kd)
	wrap(v, kd, func(old interp.BuiltinFunc) interp.BuiltinFunc {
		return func(m *interp.VM, args []interp.Value, named map[string]interp.Value) (interp.Value, error) {
			if err := bind.CheckNamed(ad+"()", named); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			if len(args) == 1 {
				if err := listError(ad, args[0], messages.Text(messages.H6131), ad+"("+codes.Name(codes.FnTensor)+"(...))"); err != nil {
					return nil, err
				}
			}
			d, ok := singleTensor(args)
			if !ok {
				return oldCall(ad, old, m, args, named)
			}
			r, err := safe(func() *tensor.Tensor { return fn(d.t) })
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			s := New(r)
			s.hasInts = d.hasInts
			return s, nil
		}
	})
}
